source.title: OECD City Statistics, archived by Marco Di Maio and Pasquale Somma
source.license: Mirror: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Attribution and noncommercial/share-alike conditions apply to this data adaptation.
source.quality: Secondary archive, before its interpolation step. Original OECD API values and historical FUA boundary vintages have not been independently reverified. No missing cells are imputed here.

selectionNote: Initial panel: ten cities including Madrid. Amsterdam added after Madrid failed, retaining Madrid. City selection is adaptive; this is not an unbiased ten-city success estimate.
limits: Historical secondary-source benchmarks, not current-world forecasts.
Occupation-mix effects are not trained: no matching observed occupation panel was acquired.
GDP/head and output/employed are arithmetic derivatives, not independent validations.
Simulation ranges use training innovations and are not calibrated coverage guarantees.
